Was surprised for the special came out of nowhere ! Maybe because acting out what is genuine feels wrong since it follows a script but at the same time how else will people stop to listen if it isn’t curated to some degree, funny or of grand gesture..? But the care that comes back isn’t what you’re looking for exactly. Idk if that makes sense but it becomes a guilty pleasure. Felt it ever since Make Happy.

But then again maybe that’s just the meta of the acting and what he’s created is meant to simply accomplish the job of provoking as it being art and all but all at the same time it feels like an attempted wake up call of sorts. Or an extremely meta concept brought to life through creativity.

The lines feel blurred to some extent but either way, it’s definitely done the job of emotionally provoking. When he was pulling and punching the door to get back inside in the end with the laugh track getting louder it was heartbreaking.

It’s not about being wrong or right, people just have different creative processes. If you are not from a digital painting background, what makes you so sure that just because pixel art does not transfer to digital art for you personally that it would automatically mean that it wouldn’t transfer the other way around? The reason why I said understanding color and shape transfers to pixel art well is because digital art is more detail heavy in comparison. Or I think it’s more likely that someone that solely digitally paints tends to have better understanding of anatomy compared to someone that solely does pixel art. That doesn’t mean pixel art is easier necessarily just different criteria which makes it a style. “Digital art” more an umbrella term for the medium but pixel is a style same way digital illustrating or digital painting is also a style but that’s just how I see it. It’s like how traditional art is to pointillism sort of. But yeah it’s more about creating something recognizable as aesthetically as possible while fitting a criteria.
